analysis_scope: One selected V223 32K target-prefill CUPTI window; it does not establish whole-run performance or semantic quality

previous_candidate_reference.scope_note: Prior-run context only; these figures are not measured by this trace analyzer.

primary_baseline.comparison_status: Compare against the actual V218 target-prefill measurement with this configuration; this trace summary does not contain that baseline measurement.

cpu_ple_attribution.interpretation: R4 records GPU kernel, memcpy, runtime API, and device activity; CPU PLE work cannot be attributed from these records alone.

device_memcpy_activity.interpretation: CUPTI MEMCPY activity duration/bytes are reported separately from host runtime API intervals.

interpretation_limits: Per-device kernel union removes overlap among kernels on that device.
Six-GPU concurrency is a sweep over the six per-device kernel unions, not a count of kernel records.
Kernel duration sums may exceed window wall time and are not busy percentages.
Runtime API host duration and device memcpy duration are separate measurements.
No host scheduler, driver API, or CUPTI OSRT activity is inferred.
Graph-launch host API calls and graph-associated device kernel records are separate observations, not interchangeable replay counts.
No-runtime-API/no-kernel intervals do not measure host CPU idle time.
CPU PLE activity is not inferable without explicit markers.
Partial known-kinds mode analyzes only the serialized known R4 event types; GPU union and concurrency are lower bounds, not complete activity timelines.
unknown_activity_kinds is a collector-global counter without kind ID, timestamp, device, context, stream, or selected-window attribution; unknown categories and phases cannot be recovered.
Zero-drop counters for known activity kinds do not establish that unknown activity kinds were absent or safely accounted for.

kernel_activity.interpretation: Graph-associated device kernel activity records are distinct from host cudaGraphLaunch API calls and do not equal a graph-launch or replay count.

partial_known_kinds.gpu_kernel_union: lower-bound observation of known kernel activity
partial_known_kinds.six_gpu_concurrency: known-kernel-only histogram; instantaneous known active-device count is a lower bound, but exact all-activity bins are unknown
partial_known_kinds.unknown_counter_scope: collector-global; no kind ID, timestamp, device, context, stream, or selected-window tags

any_thread_api_vs_any_gpu_kernel_union.interpretation: Temporal interval comparison only. API-only and neither-observed spans are not CPU-idle measurements; API activity does not establish a host stall or causal GPU wait.

graph_launch_host_api_calls.interpretation: Count of observed host runtime graph-launch API intervals; distinct from graph-associated device kernel activity records.

runtime_api_host_time.interpretation: CUPTI runtime API intervals are host API durations; they are not device memcpy durations or GPU busy time.
